import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RationalDifferentialResidue
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalOrderFactorization

/-!
# Logarithmic differentials and their residues

Logarithmic differentiation takes products of nonzero rational functions to
sums. Local units have regular logarithmic differentials, while the logarithmic
differential of any uniformizer has residue one for every residue parameter.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- The logarithmic differential of a nonzero rational function. -/
def curveLogDifferential (f : X.left.functionFieldˣ) : CurveRationalDifferentials X :=
  (f : X.left.functionField)⁻¹ • KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField f

theorem curveLogDifferential_mul (f g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    curveLogDifferential X (f * g) =
      curveLogDifferential X f + curveLogDifferential X g := by
  simp only [curveLogDifferential, Units.val_mul, Derivation.leibniz,
    mul_inv_rev, smul_add, smul_smul]
  rw [show (g : X.left.functionField)⁻¹ * (f : X.left.functionField)⁻¹ * f =
    (g : X.left.functionField)⁻¹ by field_simp,
    show (g : X.left.functionField)⁻¹ * (f : X.left.functionField)⁻¹ * g =
      (f : X.left.functionField)⁻¹ by field_simp, add_comm]

@[simp]
theorem curveLogDifferential_one : curveLogDifferential X 1 = 0 := by
  simp [curveLogDifferential]

/-- Logarithmic differentiation as a homomorphism from the multiplicative
group of nonzero rational functions to the additive differential group. -/
def curveLogDifferentialHom : Additive (X.left.functionFieldˣ) →+
    CurveRationalDifferentials X where
  toFun f := curveLogDifferential X (Additive.toMul f)
  map_zero' := curveLogDifferential_one X
  map_add' f g := curveLogDifferential_mul X (Additive.toMul f) (Additive.toMul g)

theorem curveLogDifferential_zpow (f : X.left.functionFieldˣ) (n : ℤ) :
    curveLogDifferential X (f ^ n) = n • curveLogDifferential X f :=
  map_zsmul (curveLogDifferentialHom X) n (Additive.ofMul f)

/-- A local unit has a regular logarithmic differential. -/
theorem curveLogDifferential_localUnit_mem_regular (x : X.left)
    (v : (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ) :
    curveLogDifferential X (Units.map
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField) v) ∈
        curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  refine ⟨(v⁻¹ : (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ).val •
    KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) v, ?_⟩
  simp only [map_smul, KaehlerDifferential.map_D, curveLogDifferential, Units.coe_map]
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField, map_units_inv]
  rfl

variable [IsAlgClosed k] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- The residue of a local unit's logarithmic differential is zero. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_log_localUnit
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (v : (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      (curveLogDifferential X (Units.map
        (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField) v)) = 0 :=
  curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_of_regular X hx t ht
    (curveLogDifferential_localUnit_mem_regular X x v)

/-- Every uniformizer has logarithmic residue one, even when the residue
is computed with a different parameter. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_log_uniformizer
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (hsK : algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField s ≠ 0) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      (curveLogDifferential X (Units.mk0 _ hsK)) = 1 := by
  have hlog : curveLogDifferential X (Units.mk0 _ hsK) =
      (curveUniformizerLogDifferential X hx s hs : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
    simp only [curveLogDifferential, Units.val_mk0,
      curveUniformizerLogDifferential_coe, KaehlerDifferential.map_D]
  rw [hlog, curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_simplePole]
  exact curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_logDifferential X hx s hs

omit [IsAlgClosed k] in
/-- The singular part of a logarithmic differential is the local order
times the logarithmic differential of the specified uniformizer. -/
theorem exists_curveLogDifferential_eq_regular_add
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    ∃ η : CurveStalkDifferentials X x,
      curveLogDifferential X g =
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField η +
          Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx g) •
            (curveUniformizerLogDifferential X hx t ht : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_unit_mul_parameter_orderZAt X hx t ht g
  have htK : algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ≠ 0 :=
    map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero
  have hg : g = Units.map
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField) a *
        (Units.mk0 _ htK) ^ Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx g) := by
    apply Units.ext
    convert ha using 1
    simp only [Units.val_mul, Units.coe_map, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val,
      Units.val_mk0]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := curveLogDifferential_localUnit_mem_regular X x a
  refine ⟨η, ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [hg, curveLogDifferential_mul, curveLogDifferential_zpow]
  rw [hη]
  congr 2
  simp only [curveLogDifferential, Units.val_mk0,
    curveUniformizerLogDifferential_coe, KaehlerDifferential.map_D]

omit [IsAlgClosed k] in
/-- Logarithmic differentials have at most simple poles, including in
positive characteristic when an order can vanish in the coefficient field. -/
theorem curveLogDifferential_mem_simplePole
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    curveLogDifferential X g ∈ curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := exists_curveLogDifferential_eq_regular_add X hx t ht g
  rw [hη]
  exact (curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x).add_mem
    (curveRegularDifferentialLattice_le_simplePole X x ⟨η, rfl⟩)
    ((curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x).toAddSubgroup.zsmul_mem
      (curveUniformizerLogDifferential X hx t ht).property _)

/-- The residue of a logarithmic differential is the integer local order,
mapped to the ground field. The statement holds for every residue parameter. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_log_eq_order
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      (curveLogDifferential X g) = ((Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx g) : ℤ) : k) := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := exists_curveLogDifferential_eq_regular_add X hx t ht g
  rw [hη, map_add, map_zsmul,
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_of_regular X hx t ht ⟨η, rfl⟩,
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_simplePole,
    curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_logDifferential, zero_add, zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

/-- The intrinsic simple-pole residue of a logarithmic differential is its
local order in the ground field. -/
theorem curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_log_eq_order
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx
      ⟨curveLogDifferential X g, curveLogDifferential_mem_simplePole X hx g⟩ =
        ((Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx g) : ℤ) : k) := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
  rw [← curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_simplePole X hx t ht]
  exact curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_log_eq_order X hx t ht g

end
end Hartshorne
